about: Performance budgets (docs/spec/14-quality.md#performance-budgets). Protected: never loosen a value to pass (a loosened budget needs the maintainer's D-entry and a Budget-Changed trailer). Fields: budget = the target; cmp = lt (value < budget) or le (value <= budget); kind = timing (x1.5 CI allowance, one re-measure) or memory, size, tokens, cpu (exact); from = the milestone it starts gating; script = the measurement (run with the ids it should measure; prints one JSON line per id); quick = the fast check that --quick runs instead; job = nightly for budgets measured only there; no script = PENDING (fails once its milestone is done); per_os = the target per OS (linux, darwin, win32) in place of budget, an OS not listed prints REPORT; on_ci = report: with --ci the real-app value prints REPORT and its quick check gates (D-146, D-155); local = per-OS targets from the maintainer's machine, used without --ci; median_of = the script reports that many samples and their median is gated at x1 (D-152). Targets per OS only go down. MB and KB are decimal (10^6, 10^3 bytes).
